project_type: Vanilla JS web app with Node.js backend - Resume Roaster
build_system: None - no build step required. Pure Node.js built-in modules only (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, npm registry blocked)
test_framework: Node.js built-in assert module and test runner (node:test available in Node 22)
verification_instructions: 1. Run syntax check on all .js files. 2. Run node:test tests. 3. Start server and hit /api/health endpoint. 4. Verify static files serve correctly.
setup_instructions: 1. Copy .env.example to .env. 2. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. 3. Run: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node server/index.js
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm install WILL NOT WORK. All packages are blocked at the registry. Must use ONLY Node.js built-in modules (http, https, fs, path, crypto, url, querystring, zlib, stream, etc.). No Express, no dotenv, no multer, no pdf-parse, no mammoth. NODE_OPTIONS env var has a broken preload path - must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running node commands.
key_patterns: Custom HTTP server using node:http. Custom multipart parser for file uploads. Custom .env parser. For PDF: basic text extraction from PDF streams. For DOCX: unzip XML and extract text (DOCX is a ZIP of XML files - use node:zlib). Anthropic API via node:https direct HTTP request.
directory_structure: server/ - Node.js backend (HTTP server, routes, lib utilities). public/ - Static frontend (HTML, CSS, JS). server/tests/ - Test files using node:test. server/lib/ - Shared utilities (env loader, router, multipart parser, rate limiter, Claude client, file parser).
